changes.to: Maker product page for the full-size biped (cyb-org.cn/index.php?id=6, checked 2026-11-17): height x width x thickness 1800 x 578 x 327 mm, 62 DoF, dual-arm load over 20 kg (payload_kg), slopes over 10 deg, 15 cm obstacles, self-recovery after a fall, 45 N.s impulse resistance, one-minute hot-swap batteries (main 48 V 15000 mAh on SE / 48 V 30000 mAh on PRO, plus a 48 V 3500 mAh backup), a 12-core 275 TOPS perception platform, LiDAR with IMU and a six-axis force sensor, fisheye plus RGB-D cameras, Wi-Fi 5 / BT 5.2 / 5G. Weight: the page table gives 75 kg (SE) and 80 kg (PRO); the PRO figure is recorded and the SE value noted here (the WRC exhibitor listing cites 70 kg). battery_wh = 48 V x 30 Ah = 1440 Wh for the PRO main pack, computed, excluding the 3.5 Ah backup. No runtime or IP rating is published.
Shenzhen Cyborg's full-size bipedal industrial humanoid with 62 DoF and 20 kg dual-arm load for inspection, logistics and heavy-industry work.
